jobs.title: Senior Planning Officer (Development Management)
jobs.description:
Before applying for this role, please read the following information about this opportunity found below.

Location: Brecon

Salary: £41,177 - £44,253 per annum

Vacancy Type: Permanent, Full time (37 hours per annum)

Closing Date: 21st of September 2026

National Parks were designated in order to protect beautiful areas for the benefit of the nation. They came about as a result of the 1949 National Parks and Access to the Countryside Act, which put a legislative framework in place for the establishment of National Parks in England and Wales.

The first two National Parks were designated in 1951 and in 1957 the Bannau Brycheiniog National Park was designated covering an area of some 520 square miles (1346 sq. kilometres). Until 1995 the Bannau Brycheiniog National Park Authority was a joint committee of the then local County Councils until the Environment Act of that year laid down legislation to establish National Park Authorities as independent, special purpose Local Authorities.

Job Purpose

To deal with all aspects of Planning development management casework in the National Park and on the fringes of the National Park
To assist the Principal Planning Officers in managing the Planning Development Management function in order to deliver a quality planning service, to achieve and maintain high levels of performance.
To help to ensure that the Authority’s statutory responsibilities are carried out in accordance with Government legislation, policy, procedure and guidance and accord with National Park statutory purposes.
To help to ensure that the Planning service is efficient, effective, responsive, fair, inclusive and open to examination

MAIN DUTIES

Undertake the processing of Development Control casework, including but not limited to complex and major planning and related applications, advertisement consents, conservation area consent. listed building consent applications and planning enforcement matters.
Carry out site inspections, supervision and instructions in respect of consultations, preparation of reports and recommendations. Presentation of nondelegated applications and other development control related matters to Planning Committee.
Peer review delegated decision reports and planning contravention notices on behalf of the Principal Planning Officers and the Head of Development Management in line with the Scheme of Delegation.
To undertake when appropriate, EIA screening and provide EIA screening and scoping opinions formally on behalf of the Authority.
Negotiating with agents, developers, internal consultees and statutory bodies in respect of all planning related work, including development plan preparation, planning applications, pre-application enquiries, the negotiation of Section 106 Agreements and providing design and sustainable development advice.
Dealing with preliminary and formal pre-application enquiries in respect of developments within the National Park and major developments on the fringes of the National Park

PERSON SPECIFICATION

Essential Criteria

A recognised qualification, degree or equivalent in Town and Country Planning or a related discipline
A minimum of 5 years relevant experience in Development Management in the public or private sector
Good knowledge of planning policy, related legislation and procedures Ability to work on own initiative & organise workload effectively
Ability to work under pressure
Good communication, interpersonal and report writing skills including proof reading
Ability to organise meetings with appropriate follow-up work
Ability to research, interpret and analyse a variety of complex data
An ability to work as part of a team and to mentor and support colleagues as a point of reference on planning related issues
The ability to mentor and train junior members of staff
A good telephone manner and ability to deal diplomatically with the public, National Park Members and staff
Current driving licence
Welsh Level 1

Desirable Criteria

Membership of the RTPI
Knowledge of the Brecon Beacons National Park and its statutory
Familiarity with Sustainability Appraisals
Current driving licence
Welsh Level 2

Note on Welsh Language Requirement Please note: If you do not meet the Welsh language Requirements specified, then the Authority offers a variety of learning options and staff support to help you meet these requirements during your employment with us.

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Bannau Brycheiniog National Park, please click apply to be redirected to our website to complete your application

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (West Germany)
jobs.description:
Company Overview

GreenSketch is a full-stack, AI-driven solar industry ecosystem platform. Developed by OSW Group, it is the world’s first free, end-to-end solar and battery design platform created for solar professionals, connecting the industry with homeowners, installers, and leading solar brands with unprecedented speed, intelligence and transparency. From rooftop mapping, battery system layouts, to instant quotes, GreenSketch supports lead generation to enhance efficiency across the clean energy industry.

Role Summary

As a Customer Success Manager, you are the main point of contact for our installer partners in the Western Germany. You ensure successful onboarding, strong adoption and long-term customer satisfaction.
You work closely with installers, understand their real-world challenges and help them embed Greensketch into their daily operations.

Key Responsibilities

Onboard new installation partners and guide them through their first projects in Greensketch
Act as the trusted advisor for customers after go-live
Drive product adoption and long-term usage across planning, ordering, and documentation workflows
Conduct online demos, trainings and occasional on-site visits
Identify customer needs, blockers and improvement opportunities
Collaborate closely with Product, Development and Support teams
Proactively manage renewals, upsells and customer retention
Represent the voice of installers internally

Key Deliverables / KPIs

Installer Onboarding at Scale Deliverable: Enable small and medium-sized installation companies to start working productively with Greensketch without friction or hand-holding. KPI: % of new installers completing onboarding and finishing their first real project within 30–45 days
Fast and Visible Installer Value Deliverable: Ensure installers experience clear operational value from Greensketch early in their usage. KPI: Median time-to-first-completed project after account creation
Daily Operational Usage Deliverable: Embed Greensketch into the installer’s day-to-day planning and administrative workflows. KPI: % of active installers running multiple projects per month in Greensketch
Sustainable Long-Term Adoption Deliverable: Build trust and long-term usage among installer partners in a non-contractual environment. KPI: 6-month active installer retention rate (continued project activity)

Required Qualifications & Experience

Education: Degree or vocational training in a relevant field or comparable professional experience.
Years of experience: Experience working with SMB customers and First CSM experience.
Relevant industry background: Solar PV and Battery Installation as well as Vertical SaaS for Trades & Field Services.
Languages: Fluent written and spoken German and English required, due to customer-facing responsibilities. Additional European languages are considered a plus

Skills & Competencies

Technical skills: able to confidently use web-based SaaS tools and understand solar PV planning data project structures and documentation at a practical level.
Functional expertise: experienced in onboarding and enabling small and medium-sized customers to adopt a product and integrate it into their daily operational workflows.
Behavioural competencies: builds trust through clear honest communication takes ownership of customer outcomes and works pragmatically in a fast-moving startup environment.

Preferred / Nice‑to‑Have

Hands-on experience with solar installer workflows.
Experience onboarding customers to complex B2B SaaS.
Ability to collect structured feedback and work with Product.

Working Relationships

Internal: primarily CSM Team, Support, Product, Marketing
External: installation partners, possibly wholesale later, social media

Travel Requirements

Willingness to travel up to 40% of the working time within the assigned region.

jobs.title: Assistant Planner
jobs.description:
Weekly Hours: 37.5 Hours / Week

Title: Assistant Planner

Location: Town Hall

Bargaining Unit: Non-Union

Hiring Range: $66,004.06 - $69,784.00 Annually (DOQ)

Department & Supervisor: Planning & Economic Development Director

Summary

The Town of Shrewsbury is seeking a motivated Assistant Planner to join our dedicated, highly collaborative Planning and Economic Development department. Working alongside our Director, Assistant Director, co-Assistant Planner, and Administrative Assistant, you will play a central role in driving high-visibility municipal initiatives, including Comprehensive Master Planning, Multi-Use Trail expansions, Complete Streets projects, and more.

This position offers the perfect blend of technical land-use management, creative project leadership, and career growth. You will contribute to initiatives involving transportation, land use, housing, economic development, and project management. Serving as a crucial liaison to key boards such as the Planning Board, Zoning Board of Appeals, Affordable Housing Trust, and Community Preservation Committee, you will guide applicants, facilitate public engagement, and help shape sustainable policy. The Planning & Economic Development Department offers an environment where you can sharpen your technical skills, grow as a municipal leader, and actively shape the future of Shrewsbury.

What You'll Do

Assist with community outreach initiatives, comprehensive master plan development, open space and recreation planning, drafting and revising bylaws and zoning amendments, conducting economic development research, and identifying, applying for, and administering grant opportunities.
Maintain accurate records of active and past projects, prepare and track legal notices and advertisements, assist applicants with completing submissions, and ensure compliance with conditions of approval.
Facilitate plan reviews by coordinating input from Town departments, including the Engineering Division, Conservation Commission, Building Inspector, and external consultants. Assist with community outreach and engagement strategies including in person presentations, charrettes and social media postings.
Serve as a resource for residents, landowners, and developers, providing guidance on permitting and economic development matters via phone, email, and in person. Help facilitate public discussion on critical local projects.
Provide comprehensive staff support to land use boards and committees, including preparing meeting agendas and materials, documenting outcomes, and ensuring follow-up. Help facilitate local decision making processes and develop data driven solutions based on community input.
Review and approve building permits tied to land use decisions using the Town’s permitting system. Ensure projects align with local conditions of approval and help guide the development process through implementation.

Qualifications

Master’s degree in planning, geography, landscape architecture, public administration, or related field preferred, with 1 - 3 years of experience in municipal or consulting planning, or any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Valid Massachusetts driver’s license.

Work Hours & Benefits

The Assistant Planner works in a very collaborative team environment from a shared office space at Shrewsbury Town Hall with the staff from both the Planning & Building Inspection departments. Standard work hours are Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday from 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM; Tuesday from 8:00 AM to 6:30 PM; and Friday from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. The Assistant Planner may attend board and committee meetings as well as community events regarding new developments and is paid for this time through a stipend (and overtime if the meeting runs long).

The Town of Shrewsbury offers a comprehensive benefits package featuring health insurance, a public pension system, generous paid time off (vacation and sick leave), professional development opportunities, and an extensive Employee Assistance Program. Additionally, Shrewsbury is one of the first municipalities in the Commonwealth to provide employer-funded Paid Family & Medical Leave, allowing eligible employees to take paid leave without requiring employee-paid contributions.

How To Apply

If you are a proactive, detail-oriented professional who can balance competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, have a growth mindset, and a passion for community development, we encourage you to apply.

To learn more about this position please review the full job description. When applying for this position a cover letter and resume may be sent via email to Lilianne Exinor, Human Resources Coordinator, at jobs@shrewsburyma.gov indicating the position you are applying for in the subject line. The initial review of applicants will begin on September 14, 2026. The position is open until filled.

Duties

Help

You will serve as a Weaponeering Subject Matter Expert.
You will serve as subject matter expert on United States Chairman Joint Chiefs of Staff Targeting, Weaponeering, Collateral Damage Estimation, International Convention of Laws of Armed Conflict Policies.
You will perform qualitative analysis of cruise missile employment issues providing input and recommendations to Joint Staff, Combatant Commands, Services, Agencies (CC/S/As), and other elements of the national intelligence community.
You will lead the production of electronic targeting folders ensuring accuracy and completeness and policy compliance of all materials necessary to support cruise and hypersonic missile strike planning.
You will develop methods to measure quality control of tasked targets assigned to other division personnel and techniques to validate production data.

You will provide and perform work that focuses on planning, analyzing, or administering the agency aviation programs, which requires the application of pilot knowledge and skills.

Requirements

jobs.title: DWM GIS Analyst (AIM)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Posting expires: September 8, 2026

Salary range: $54,863 - $75,000

General Description and Classification Standards:

This is a full-time, professional level position within the Geographic Information System function of the Department of Watershed Management, City of Atlanta. GIS Analyst leverages geospatial and GPS resources to collect data, create maps, perform technical research, spatial analysis, and produce graphic reports. The planning and support of simultaneous tasks and GIS projects with a committed approach to teamwork, interpersonal skills, and collaboration is essential for this role. GIS Analysts are both subject matter experts and cross-functional leaders. The candidate should have the technical agility, focus, and flexibility to work independently and in a group environment and may act as departmental liaison with other internal agencies.

Supervision Received:

Receives nominal guidance regarding workflow, projects, and objectives. Assigned tasks are typically executed individually with periodic team collaboration.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

These are typical responsibilities for this position and should not be construed as exclusive or all inclusive.

Compiles, manipulates, and analyzes geospatial data

Performs, designs, and implements advanced analysis methods
Investigates & interprets survey maps/plats
Produces shapefiles and CAD files for data distribution
Creates digitized GIS maps observing cartographic methods
Responds to general inquiries from peers & interdepartmental staff
Follows established work methods, timetables, performance standards
Completes assigned tasks in an accurate and timely manner
Assists with updates to operating procedures
Follows standards set forth in Data Sharing process
May train users in the implementation of a new system
May present ideas in front of small to medium sized groups
May act as a lead to peers, interns, or consultant staff
May perform other duties as assigned.

The above statements reflect the general duties, responsibilities and competencies considered necessary to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the job and should not be considered as a detailed description of all the work requirements of the position. COA may change the specific job duties with or without prior notice based on the needs of the organization.

Knowledge Skills and Abilities:

This is a partial listing of necessary knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform the job successfully, it is not an exhaustive list.

Highly skilled in GIS principles, concepts, methodology, and technical skills
Extensive experience with ESRI ArcGIS Suite; Pro, Online, & mobile Applications
Proficient with shapefiles, geodatabases, feature layers, web maps, instant apps, feature layers, coordinate systems, projections, SDE environment editing, spatial analysis, and cartographic schema
Strong analytical skills, quantitative skills, and ability to conceptualize and interpret spatial data
Able to think critically, abstractly and resolve most issues without escalation
Demonstrates initiative, a cooperative nature, and contributes to team dynamic
Innovative, organized and detail oriented when managing multiple priorities
Effective verbal and written communication skills
Able to lead, train and support less experienced staff
Acts with a well-developed professional business acumen
Self-motivated with initiative and commitment to learning/growth opportunities.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education and Experience - Bachelor’s Degree in GIS, Geography, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; and two (2) years of specific GIS work experience.

Licensures and Certifications - None required.

Preferred Requirements - Master’s Degree in GIS, Geography, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field with five (5) years of experience.

Work Environment:

Required physical, lifting, and sensory capabilities are requirements to perform the job successfully. Typical environmental conditions associated with the job.

Lifting Requirements:

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body.

Work Schedule:

This position follows the City’s hybrid work schedule policy as assigned by the Department of Human Resources Commissioner and requires in-person work at City worksites/facilities at least four (4) days per week, with the option to work remotely one (1) day per week, based on eligibility, departmental needs, and supervisor approval. The hybrid work schedule is subject to change at any time to five (5) days in-person work.

How can you make an impact?

This remote Customer Success Representative will support college-level faculty and administrators by providing guidance, training, and resources to help them successfully use our solutions. The role focuses on improving educational outcomes, student engagement, affordability, access, and equity while building strong customer relationships that drive loyalty and retention. The CSR will partner closely with Sales and other Customer Success team members to manage customer pipelines and track progress. Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of McGraw Hill Higher Education’s digital products, including Connect and SIMnet, as well as foundational learning science and instructional design concepts.

The work you do at McGraw Hill will be work that matters. As the leading education

Play your part and experience a sense of fulfilment that will inspire you to even greater

National Parks were designated in order to protect beautiful areas for the benefit of the nation. They came about as a result of the 1949 National Parks and Access to the Countryside Act, which put a legislative framework in place for the establishment of National Parks in England and Wales.

The first two National Parks were designated in 1951 and in 1957 the Bannau Brycheiniog National Park was designated covering an area of some 520 square miles (1346 sq. kilometres). Until 1995 the Bannau Brycheiniog National Park Authority was a joint committee of the then local County Councils until the Environment Act of that year laid down legislation to establish National Park Authorities as independent, special purpose Local Authorities.

Job Purpose

To deal with all aspects of Planning development management casework in the National Park and on the fringes of the National Park
To assist the Principal Planning Officers in managing the Planning Development Management function in order to deliver a quality planning service, to achieve and maintain high levels of performance.
To help to ensure that the Authority’s statutory responsibilities are carried out in accordance with Government legislation, policy, procedure and guidance and accord with National Park statutory purposes.
To help to ensure that the Planning service is efficient, effective, responsive, fair, inclusive and open to examination

MAIN DUTIES

Undertake the processing of Development Control casework, including but not limited to complex and major planning and related applications, advertisement consents, conservation area consent. listed building consent applications and planning enforcement matters.
Carry out site inspections, supervision and instructions in respect of consultations, preparation of reports and recommendations. Presentation of nondelegated applications and other development control related matters to Planning Committee.
Peer review delegated decision reports and planning contravention notices on behalf of the Principal Planning Officers and the Head of Development Management in line with the Scheme of Delegation.
To undertake when appropriate, EIA screening and provide EIA screening and scoping opinions formally on behalf of the Authority.
Negotiating with agents, developers, internal consultees and statutory bodies in respect of all planning related work, including development plan preparation, planning applications, pre-application enquiries, the negotiation of Section 106 Agreements and providing design and sustainable development advice.
Dealing with preliminary and formal pre-application enquiries in respect of developments within the National Park and major developments on the fringes of the National Park

Current driving licence
Welsh Level 1

Membership of the RTPI

Current driving licence
Welsh Level 2

GreenSketch is a full-stack, AI-driven solar industry ecosystem platform. Developed by OSW Group, it is the world’s first free, end-to-end solar and battery design platform created for solar professionals, connecting the industry with homeowners, installers, and leading solar brands with unprecedented speed, intelligence and transparency. From rooftop mapping, battery system layouts, to instant quotes, GreenSketch supports lead generation to enhance efficiency across the clean energy industry.

Role Summary

As a Customer Success Manager, you are the main point of contact for our installer partners in the Western Germany. You ensure successful onboarding, strong adoption and long-term customer satisfaction.
You work closely with installers, understand their real-world challenges and help them embed Greensketch into their daily operations.

Key Responsibilities

Onboard new installation partners and guide them through their first projects in Greensketch
Act as the trusted advisor for customers after go-live
Drive product adoption and long-term usage across planning, ordering, and documentation workflows
Conduct online demos, trainings and occasional on-site visits
Identify customer needs, blockers and improvement opportunities
Collaborate closely with Product, Development and Support teams
Proactively manage renewals, upsells and customer retention
Represent the voice of installers internally

Key Deliverables / KPIs

Installer Onboarding at Scale Deliverable: Enable small and medium-sized installation companies to start working productively with Greensketch without friction or hand-holding. KPI: % of new installers completing onboarding and finishing their first real project within 30–45 days
Fast and Visible Installer Value Deliverable: Ensure installers experience clear operational value from Greensketch early in their usage. KPI: Median time-to-first-completed project after account creation
Daily Operational Usage Deliverable: Embed Greensketch into the installer’s day-to-day planning and administrative workflows. KPI: % of active installers running multiple projects per month in Greensketch
Sustainable Long-Term Adoption Deliverable: Build trust and long-term usage among installer partners in a non-contractual environment. KPI: 6-month active installer retention rate (continued project activity)

Education: Degree or vocational training in a relevant field or comparable professional experience.
Years of experience: Experience working with SMB customers and First CSM experience.
Relevant industry background: Solar PV and Battery Installation as well as Vertical SaaS for Trades & Field Services.
Languages: Fluent written and spoken German and English required, due to customer-facing responsibilities. Additional European languages are considered a plus

Skills & Competencies

Technical skills: able to confidently use web-based SaaS tools and understand solar PV planning data project structures and documentation at a practical level.
Functional expertise: experienced in onboarding and enabling small and medium-sized customers to adopt a product and integrate it into their daily operational workflows.
Behavioural competencies: builds trust through clear honest communication takes ownership of customer outcomes and works pragmatically in a fast-moving startup environment.

Preferred / Nice‑to‑Have

Hands-on experience with solar installer workflows.
Experience onboarding customers to complex B2B SaaS.
Ability to collect structured feedback and work with Product.

Working Relationships

Internal: primarily CSM Team, Support, Product, Marketing
External: installation partners, possibly wholesale later, social media

Willingness to travel up to 40% of the working time within the assigned region.

new_jobs.title: Assistant Planner
new_jobs.description:
Weekly Hours: 37.5 Hours / Week

Title: Assistant Planner

Location: Town Hall

Bargaining Unit: Non-Union

Hiring Range: $66,004.06 - $69,784.00 Annually (DOQ)

Department & Supervisor: Planning & Economic Development Director

Summary

The Town of Shrewsbury is seeking a motivated Assistant Planner to join our dedicated, highly collaborative Planning and Economic Development department. Working alongside our Director, Assistant Director, co-Assistant Planner, and Administrative Assistant, you will play a central role in driving high-visibility municipal initiatives, including Comprehensive Master Planning, Multi-Use Trail expansions, Complete Streets projects, and more.

This position offers the perfect blend of technical land-use management, creative project leadership, and career growth. You will contribute to initiatives involving transportation, land use, housing, economic development, and project management. Serving as a crucial liaison to key boards such as the Planning Board, Zoning Board of Appeals, Affordable Housing Trust, and Community Preservation Committee, you will guide applicants, facilitate public engagement, and help shape sustainable policy. The Planning & Economic Development Department offers an environment where you can sharpen your technical skills, grow as a municipal leader, and actively shape the future of Shrewsbury.

What You'll Do

Assist with community outreach initiatives, comprehensive master plan development, open space and recreation planning, drafting and revising bylaws and zoning amendments, conducting economic development research, and identifying, applying for, and administering grant opportunities.
Maintain accurate records of active and past projects, prepare and track legal notices and advertisements, assist applicants with completing submissions, and ensure compliance with conditions of approval.
Facilitate plan reviews by coordinating input from Town departments, including the Engineering Division, Conservation Commission, Building Inspector, and external consultants. Assist with community outreach and engagement strategies including in person presentations, charrettes and social media postings.
Serve as a resource for residents, landowners, and developers, providing guidance on permitting and economic development matters via phone, email, and in person. Help facilitate public discussion on critical local projects.
Provide comprehensive staff support to land use boards and committees, including preparing meeting agendas and materials, documenting outcomes, and ensuring follow-up. Help facilitate local decision making processes and develop data driven solutions based on community input.
Review and approve building permits tied to land use decisions using the Town’s permitting system. Ensure projects align with local conditions of approval and help guide the development process through implementation.

Qualifications

Master’s degree in planning, geography, landscape architecture, public administration, or related field preferred, with 1 - 3 years of experience in municipal or consulting planning, or any equivalent combination of education and experience.
Valid Massachusetts driver’s license.

Work Hours & Benefits

The Assistant Planner works in a very collaborative team environment from a shared office space at Shrewsbury Town Hall with the staff from both the Planning & Building Inspection departments. Standard work hours are Monday, Wednesday, and Thursday from 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM; Tuesday from 8:00 AM to 6:30 PM; and Friday from 8:00 AM to 12:00 PM. The Assistant Planner may attend board and committee meetings as well as community events regarding new developments and is paid for this time through a stipend (and overtime if the meeting runs long).

The Town of Shrewsbury offers a comprehensive benefits package featuring health insurance, a public pension system, generous paid time off (vacation and sick leave), professional development opportunities, and an extensive Employee Assistance Program. Additionally, Shrewsbury is one of the first municipalities in the Commonwealth to provide employer-funded Paid Family & Medical Leave, allowing eligible employees to take paid leave without requiring employee-paid contributions.

How To Apply

If you are a proactive, detail-oriented professional who can balance competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, have a growth mindset, and a passion for community development, we encourage you to apply.

To learn more about this position please review the full job description. When applying for this position a cover letter and resume may be sent via email to Lilianne Exinor, Human Resources Coordinator, at jobs@shrewsburyma.gov indicating the position you are applying for in the subject line. The initial review of applicants will begin on September 14, 2026. The position is open until filled.

Compiles, manipulates, and analyzes geospatial data

Performs, designs, and implements advanced analysis methods
Investigates & interprets survey maps/plats
Produces shapefiles and CAD files for data distribution
Creates digitized GIS maps observing cartographic methods
Responds to general inquiries from peers & interdepartmental staff
Follows established work methods, timetables, performance standards
Completes assigned tasks in an accurate and timely manner
Assists with updates to operating procedures
Follows standards set forth in Data Sharing process
May train users in the implementation of a new system
May present ideas in front of small to medium sized groups

Highly skilled in GIS principles, concepts, methodology, and technical skills
Extensive experience with ESRI ArcGIS Suite; Pro, Online, & mobile Applications

Strong analytical skills, quantitative skills, and ability to conceptualize and interpret spatial data
Able to think critically, abstractly and resolve most issues without escalation
Demonstrates initiative, a cooperative nature, and contributes to team dynamic

new_jobs.title: Senior Solutions Consultant
new_jobs.description:
What will I be doing?

As a creative problem-solving partner for the Go to Market Team, Solution Consultants solve business challenges facing the largest enterprises and brands in the world. We consult on exciting opportunities that require deep proven experience and creativity. Our job is to simplify the complex, show quantifiable value in the solutions we propose and be a credible, trusted advisor for customers and your teammates. As part of this role, you will transform customer business pain into presentations and proof of values which clearly articulate the context and value of Adobe's products in the customer’s daily work stream. In this role you will also act as a leader and mentor to your Solutions Teammates, ensuring we continue our position at the forefront of industry knowledge, customer empathy and implementation.

Industry Focus

We are responsible for guiding and delivering the most creative solutions to the world’s most dynamic brands. If you have a creative technology background and a passion for building exceptional experiences which solve our customer’s business challenges, we want to speak to you!

What you will need to succeed:

Hands on experience using Adobe Creative Cloud Suite, Custom Models, Express, Firefly and Frame.io
Curiosity
Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong listening skills with ability to work effectively with people at all levels in an organization
Strong attention to detail, exceptionally hands-on in all the work you’re doing
Ability to clearly communicate sophisticated ideas both verbally and in writing
Organized, able to balance multiple work streams at once and multi-task
Work collaboratively in a team environment
You are a curious self-starter who is inventive and able to work on projects with minimal mentorship
Passion for developing talent
High level of energy, personal drive, and positivity

Ideal Skills & Background

Eight years professional experience in a customer facing creative operations, production, post production, digital marketing or Solutions Consulting role.
First hand experience generating content using; Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, Dall-E, OpenAI Sora, Gemini Nano Banana or similar.
Architecting API based workflows across Enterprise Tech Stacks.
Project management skills in delivering on time solutions that routinely exceed customer needs.
Experience with creative production technology systems; MAM, DAM, NLE’s, and other related systems
Experience scripting or coding in Python or JavaScript, a plus.
Concepts of Authentication and Authorization through Active Directory, OKTA or other enterprise directory services
Fundamental understanding of cloud architecture. AWS , Azure architecture a plus.
Familiar and skilled with graphics programs to craft presentations; Adobe XD, Figma, PowerPoint, Miro and/or Keynote
Background in creative
Self-managed, adaptable, and dedicated to customer support
Strong verbal and writing skills
Strong interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills
Experience with Workfront, Dynamics 365 and/or Airtable a plus
Experience using Adobe Workfront Fusion and/or Microsoft Power Automate
Some travel may be required

About Adobe

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

Our 30,000+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Let’s Adobe together

At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Representative, Inside
new_jobs.description:
Overview

Build the Future

McGraw Hill’s Higher Education team delivers powerful platforms, highly personalized

course materials, and effective learning supplements to help students achieve their

goals at every stage of their academic and professional careers.

How can you make an impact?

This remote Customer Success Representative will support college-level faculty and administrators by providing guidance, training, and resources to help them successfully use our solutions. The role focuses on improving educational outcomes, student engagement, affordability, access, and equity while building strong customer relationships that drive loyalty and retention. The CSR will partner closely with Sales and other Customer Success team members to manage customer pipelines and track progress. This role will also focus on increasing digital product usage and supporting opportunities for customer growth.

This is a remote role open to candidates residing in the Eastern or Central Time Zone. Candidates should be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. There is a requirement for 5%-10% travel throughout the year.

What would you be doing?

Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of McGraw Hill Higher Education’s digital products, including Connect and SIMnet, as well as foundational learning science and instructional design concepts.
Utilize Salesforce and Gainsight to manage sales pipelines, track customer stages, measure pipeline velocity, and analyze customer data.
Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to assess customer needs, develop implementation plans, and support retention and new business opportunities.
Oversee implementation processes for new and returning customers, ensuring they are positioned to achieve improved outcomes and a positive experience.
Conduct one-on-one and group Zoom meetings to provide consultative guidance, training, and support tailored to customer needs and goals.
Provide timely follow-up and resolve customer issues through troubleshooting, research, and collaboration with internal teams, including Sales, Product, Implementation, and Technical Support.
Participate in team meetings, strategy sessions, and professional development while sharing customer feedback and ideas to help improve products and services.

We’re looking for someone with:

Bachelor’s Degree.
1-2 years experience in customer success or similar role related to software implementation (higher education experience highly preferred).
Exceptional communication and presentation skills to effectively train and support customers with varying levels of technical acumen and confidence.
Ability to excel in a remote setting. This is primarily a work-from-home position that requires a high level of communication, organization, and attention to detail.
Positive attitude, purpose-driven spirit, and growth mindset for embracing challenges.
Instructional design, teaching and/or coaching experience also a plus.
Experience using Salesforce and Gainsight is preferred.

Why work for us?

The work you do at McGraw Hill will be work that matters. As the leading education

partner for millions of educators, learners and professionals, we are expanding the

possibilities of content and technology to make learning better in a connected world.

Play your part and experience a sense of fulfilment that will inspire you to even greater

heights.

The pay range for this position is between $59,500 - $75,000 annually. However, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. An annual bonus plan may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical and/or other benefits, depending on the position offered. Click here to learn more about our benefit offerings.

McGraw Hill recruiters always use a “@mheducation.com” or "@careers.mheducation.com” email addresses and/or from our Applicant Tracking System, iCIMS. Any variation of this email domain should be considered suspicious. Additionally, McGraw Hill recruiters and authorized representatives will never request sensitive information in email.

new_jobs.title: Customer Success Senior Manager, M&T Nota
new_jobs.description:
Overview:

The role leads a team of Customer Success Specialists and is responsible for driving customer growth, retention, and satisfaction for M&T Nota. This role ensures law firms successfully adopt and gain value from the Nota platform while receiving exceptional banking support. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Banking teams, the Customer Success Manager serves as the voice of the customer, helping shape business improvements and supporting the continued growth of the M&T Nota venture.

A key focus of the role is building and scaling a remote servicing model that efficiently supports customers across both the Nota platform and M&T banking services. This leader will establish the processes, tools, and team capabilities needed to deliver a consistent, high-quality client experience while supporting sustainable business growth

Primary Responsibilities:

Lead and develop a team of Customer Success Specialists responsible for onboarding, training, servicing, and ongoing customer support.
Lead the execution of customer success strategies that drive customer adoption, retention, satisfaction, and growth for M&T Nota.
Oversee the development and enhancement of a scalable customer success operating model, including servicing processes, tools, and resources.
Lead initiatives to build and optimize a remote servicing model supporting both Nota platform users and related banking services.
Monitor customer success performance metrics and identify opportunities to improve client engagement, loyalty, and business outcomes.
Act as the voice of the customer by partnering with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Banking teams to improve products, resolve customer issues, enhance service delivery, and support business growth objectives.
Analyze customer feedback and operational trends to identify risks, recommend improvements, and influence strategic priorities.
Advise senior management on customer success initiatives, servicing strategies, and opportunities to improve customer outcomes.
Understand and adhere to the Company's risk and regulatory standards, policies, and controls in accordance with the Company's Risk Appetite. Identify risk-related issues needing escalation to management.
Promote an environment that supports belonging and reflects the M&T Bank brand.
Maintain M&T internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators as applicable.
Complete other related duties as assigned.

Supervisory/ Managerial Responsibilities:

Supervises a team

Education and Experience Required:

Bachelor’s degree and 7 years relevant experience,

OR in lieu of a degree,

A combined minimum of 11 years higher education and/or work experience including 7 years relevant experience

2 year of Management Experience

M&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $107,500.00 - $179,100.00 Annual (USD). The successful candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation.

Location

Buffalo, New York, United States of America
